title: Capstone seam 1: the borrow state machine
prompt: Complete `BorrowTracker`: `bool borrow(const std::string& isbn)` moves an available (or unknown) book to Borrowed and returns true — but returns false and changes nothing if it is already Borrowed. `bool give_back(...)` is the mirror for returning. `bool is_borrowed(...) const` reports state; unknown books are not borrowed.

tests.name: happy-path
tests.hint: Borrow flips Available→Borrowed; give_back flips it back.

tests.name: double-borrow
tests.hint: The second borrow must be refused, not silently succeed.

tests.name: return-unknown
tests.hint: Returning a book never borrowed is refused.
